import os,sys,tarfile,shutil
root=sys.argv[2]
with tarfile.open(sys.argv[1]) as archive:
 for item in archive:
  path=os.path.join(root,item.name)
  assert os.path.commonpath([root,os.path.abspath(path)])==root
  if item.isdir(): os.makedirs(path,exist_ok=True); continue
  os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path),exist_ok=True)
  with open(path,'xb') as target:
   if item.issym(): target.write(item.linkname.encode())
   else:
    assert item.isfile()
    with archive.extractfile(item) as source: shutil.copyfileobj(source,target)
  os.chmod(path,0o444)
